contestants.name: Taylor Kim
contestants.motive: Prove she can win under pressure and earn safety without surrendering her independence.

contestants.name: Riley Johnson
contestants.motive: Turn careful observation into one reliable partnership and a well-timed competition win.

events.text: Six housemates, one new game. Meet the cast, decide who to trust, and prepare for the first competition.
Week 1 · HoH
hold-your-ground-v3 · Hold Your Ground · Endurance. Steady pressure rises as the clock advances. Manage grip and hold for 19.5 seconds total to earn full marks.
Committed competition standings: 1. You 9.81; 2. Taylor Kim 7.73; 3. Casey Wilson 5.40; 4. Riley Johnson 4.66; 5. Maya Hassan 3.94; 6. Jamie Roberts 3.85.
This week's Have-Nots: Jamie Roberts and Maya Hassan. Slop, cold showers and the Have-Not room until the next Head of Household, and a point off their veto.

I've kept every promise I made in here, including the ones that cost me. Keep me and that doesn't change. Keeping me gives you another option in this game. Think about what helps your next move.
I'm not going to beg. I've played hard and I've played straight, and I'd like the chance to keep doing both. Don't take the easy vote just because it is easy. Show me you can choose for yourselves.
